name: Portal-frame warehouse (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Large portal-frame warehouse, 36 x 21 m with 9.2 m eaves and a low-pitch corrugated roof with roof lights: ribbed steel cladding over a precast base, clerestory glazing, three 4 m roller doors (one open) and a personnel door onto a built-in 1.2 m raised loading dock along the front, with a ramp at the west end, steps at the east end, bumpers and a steel canopy. Inside: an open floor at dock height with painted aisles and four runs of pallet racking, steel portal frames, and an office block in the rear-west corner (two ground-floor offices) whose roof is a mezzanine with an upper office, reached by a guarded stair.
